title: Architecture: orchestrator as a unified, ingested project knowledge graph (bootstrap to dissolve cold-start)
summary: Resolves the cold-start deadlock surfaced by the v1-v4 benchmark (a thin/general hand-built KB never beat a strong model; nothing compounds if unused). KEY INSIGHT (user): drop the orchestrator into an EXISTING codebase and BOOTSTRAP the KB by ingesting it — you're grounded day one, not waiting months. The graph is task/note/context = ARTIFACT-AGNOSTIC, so ingestion spans code + git history + docs/ADRs + tickets/PRs + chat + tests + schemas + assets — one unified fabric, not siloed tools. DIFFERENTIATOR vs naive enterprise-RAG: not breadth but STRUCTURE — (a) task-centric organization, (b) explicit relevance/dependency EDGES (not just embedding cosine), (c) CROSS-MODAL links (code↔ticket↔design↔doc↔reverted-commit = the senior-engineer mental model no single tool assembles), (d) outcome-learned edge weights. VALUE concentrates on the DELTA-over-reading-current-code: git history / reverted commits ('tried X, broke because Y' — NOT in current tree), PR/ADR rationale, recorded gotchas — exactly the PRECISE resolution v4 proved we lacked. Don't re-encode readable current code (redundant noise). Signal ranking: tickets/PRs/reverts/ADRs > docs/tests/schemas > code-summaries > chat(noisy) > assets(selective, caption+metadata node). RETRIEVAL LADDER over the bootstrapped graph: rung1 heuristic (DAG spreading-activation on weighted edges + cosine kNN + rank FUSION — RAG for recall to reach unwired nodes, DAG for precision/rerank, NOT DAG-gates-RAG which caps recall; lean compact+pointer delivery per v2/v3) → rung2 learned-linear weights from outcome feedback → rung3 GNN/graph-ML (link prediction, structure-aware embeddings) ONLY when data-rich. Every rung gated on KB content + verified by the W/H/C ruler. STAGED BUILD: (1) ingestion v1 = HIGH-signal sources only (git history + docs + static call-graph edges) → reviewable candidate notes/edges; (2) lean hybrid retrieval; (3) re-measure on a real task vs the cold-start floor. AUTONOMOUS-BUILD SAFETY (user away): build tooling
